## Overview

Figure 1C: 
(C) Seventeen molecular niches (N1–N17) identified by unsupervised clustering of spatial transcriptomic spots, projected onto representative tissue sections across timepoints.
(D) UMAP visualization of the spatial distribution of the 17 molecular niches. 
(E) UMAP highlighting infection-associated niches (IANs), which expand over the course of infection. 
(F) Heatmap of PROGENy pathway activity scores across the 17 molecular niches. 
(G) Heatmap of infection-associated pathway enrichment (e.g., AMPs, TLR signaling, complement, neutrophil recruitment, interferon-γ response, TNF signaling, inflammatory response, angiogenesis, EMT, myogenesis, epithelial–mesenchymal transition, ROS, apoptosis) across the 17 niches. (H) Spatial feature plots showing tissue-level activation of the TNF-α, NF-κB, hypoxia, antimicrobial peptide, inflammatory response, and apoptotic pathways across timepoints (Day 0, 1, 3, 5, 7, and 28).

Input:  Deconvolution_Six_V01262026/Pyelonephritis_Infection_Decovoluted_v01262026.rds
Output: Results/Figures/Figure1/

## Representative slices and timepoint labels
```{r slice-setup}
# Six representative sections, one per timepoint
# slice1=D0, slice3=D1, slice4=D3, slice7=D5, slice8=D7, slice9=D28
selected_slices  <- c("slice1", "slice3", "slice4", "slice7", "slice8", "slice9")
```

## Figure 1C-E: SpatialDimPlot for each section, DimPlot for UMAP visualization and infection-associated niches (IANs)

```{r fig1-E-individual-panels-setup}
# Figure 1C: SpatialDimPlot for representative sections across timepoints

pt_size_map <- c(
  slice1 = 1800, slice3 = 1800, slice4 = 1600,
  slice7 = 1600, slice8 = 1800, slice9 = 1800
)

fig1c_panels <- lapply(available_images, function(sl) {
  pt_sz <- if (sl %in% names(pt_size_map)) pt_size_map[[sl]] else 1800
  p <- SpatialDimPlot(
    Pyelonephritis_Infection,
    images         = sl,
    #cols          = niche_colors,
    pt.size.factor = pt_sz,
    crop           = TRUE,
    label          = TRUE,
    label.size     = 3,
  )
  p + theme(legend.position = "none") + coord_cartesian()
})

# Extract a shared legend from the first panel (with legend visible)
legend_plot <- SpatialDimPlot(
  Pyelonephritis_Infection,
  images         = available_images[1],
  pt.size.factor = 1800,
  crop           = TRUE,
  label          = FALSE,
) + theme(legend.position = "right")
shared_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)

# cowplot::plot_grid forces every panel into equal-sized slots regardless
# of the coord_fixed() that SpatialDimPlot sets internally
panels_row <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = fig1c_panels, nrow = 1)

Fig1cSpatialDimPlot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  panels_row, shared_legend,
  nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(length(fig1c_panels), 0.8)
)
ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure1C_SpatialDimPlot.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig1cSpatialDimPlot,
  width    = 24,
  height   = 4
)

# Figure 1D: UMAP visualization of the 17 molecular niches
Fig1DDimPlot<- DimPlot(
  Pyelonephritis_Infection,
  reduction = "umap",
  #cols      = niche_colors,
  label     = TRUE,
  repel     = TRUE) 

ggsave (
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure1D_UMAP.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig1DDimPlot,
  width    = 5,
  height   = 4
)

# Figure 1E: Highlighting infection-associated niches (IANs) in the UMAP. Based on the spatial distribution and temporal dynamics,
# we only select N12, N13, N14, N15, N16, and N17 as infection-associated niches (IANs)
# 
Selected_niches <- paste0("N", c(8,10:17))
Idents(Pyelonephritis_Infection)
Pyelonephritis_InfectionSub <- subset(Pyelonephritis_Infection, idents = Selected_niches)

Fig1EDimPlot<- DimPlot(Pyelonephritis_InfectionSub, label     = TRUE, repel     = TRUE)
ggsave (
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure1E_UMAP_IANs.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig1EDimPlot,
  width    = 5,
  height   = 4
)

```


## Figure 1F: Heatmap of PROGENy pathway activity scores across the 17 molecular niches

```{r fig1f-progeny-heatmap}
# Reset assay and identities in case a previous chunk changed them
DefaultAssay(Pyelonephritis_Infection) <- "SCT"
Idents(Pyelonephritis_Infection) <- Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data$Annotation

# Fetch PROGENy model (mouse, top 500 footprint genes)
net <- decoupleR::get_progeny(organism = "mouse", top = 500)

# Extract SCT normalized counts and run MLM activity inference
mat  <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(Pyelonephritis_Infection, assay = "SCT", layer = "data"))
acts <- run_mlm(mat = mat, net = net, .source = "source", .target = "target",
                .mor = "weight", minsize = 5)

# Store scores as a new assay and scale
Pyelonephritis_Infection[["pathwaysmlm"]] <- acts %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "source", names_from = "condition", values_from = "score") %>%
  column_to_rownames("source") %>%
  Seurat::CreateAssayObject(.)
DefaultAssay(Pyelonephritis_Infection) <- "pathwaysmlm"
Pyelonephritis_Infection <- ScaleData(Pyelonephritis_Infection)

# Average scaled activity per niche × pathway
df <- t(as.matrix(GetAssayData(Pyelonephritis_Infection, assay = "pathwaysmlm",
                                layer = "scale.data"))) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(cluster = Idents(Pyelonephritis_Infection)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -cluster, names_to = "source", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(cluster, source) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(score), .groups = "drop")

# Wide matrix rows = niches, cols = pathways; transpose for heatmap
top_acts_mat <- df %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "cluster", names_from = "source", values_from = "mean") %>%
  column_to_rownames("cluster") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Order pathways (rows) and niches (columns)
PathwayOrder      <- c("TNFa", "NFkB", "JAK-STAT", "p53", "Hypoxia", "Trail",
                       "PI3K", "EGFR", "MAPK", "WNT", "TGFb", "VEGF", "Estrogen")
NichesOrder       <- paste0("N", 1:17)
ProgenyHeatmapMat <- t(top_acts_mat)[PathwayOrder, NichesOrder]

# Symmetric color scale centered on 0 (activity z-scores range ≈ −2 to 2)
palette_length <- 100
my_color  <- colorRampPalette(c("royalblue", "white", "firebrick3"))(palette_length)
my_breaks <- c(seq(-2, 0,    length.out = ceiling(palette_length / 2) + 1),
               seq(0.05, 2,  length.out = floor(palette_length / 2)))

Fig1FProgenyHeatmap <- pheatmap(
  ProgenyHeatmapMat,
  fontsize       = 8,
  fontsize_row   = 8,
  show_rownames  = TRUE,
  cluster_cols   = FALSE,
  cluster_rows   = FALSE,
  color          = my_color,
  breaks         = my_breaks,
  main           = "PROGENy (500)",
  angle_col      = 45,
  border_color   = NA,
  treeheight_col = 0,
  treeheight_row = 0
)

pdf(file = paste0(Outdir, "Figure1F_PROGENy_Heatmap.pdf"), width = 4.5, height = 4)
print(Fig1FProgenyHeatmap)
dev.off()
# save the object
saveRDS(Pyelonephritis_Infection, file = paste0(Indir, "Pyelonephritis_Infection_Decovoluted_with_PROGENy_v05292026.rds"))

```



# Figure 1G: Heatmap of infection-associated pathway enrichment across the 17 niches
```{r fig1g-infectedCandidatePathways-heatmap}
# Here we curated the pathways based on the literature, including antimicrobial peptides (AMPs), TLR signaling, complement, neutrophil recruitment, interferon-γ response, TNF signaling, inflammatory response, angiogenesis, EMT, myogenesis, epithelial–mesenchymal transition, ROS, apoptosis, and necroptosis. We also included hallmark gene sets for angiogenesis, TGF-β signaling, epithelial–mesenchymal transition (EMT), and myogenesis from the MSigDB database.

# Query hallmark gene sets for mouse using msigdbr
msig <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "H")  # H = Hallmark
msig %>% pull(gs_name) %>% table()
hallmark_angiogenesis <- msig %>% filter(gs_name == "HALLMARK_ANGIOGENESIS") %>% pull(gene_symbol)
hallmark_tgfb <- msig %>% filter(gs_name == "HALLMARK_TGF_BETA_SIGNALING") %>% pull(gene_symbol)
hallmark_em <- msig %>% filter(gs_name == "HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION") %>% pull(gene_symbol)
hallmark_myogenesis <- msig %>% filter(gs_name == "HALLMARK_MYOGENESIS") %>% pull(gene_symbol)
# Examples:
hallmark_inflam <- msig %>% filter(gs_name == "HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE") %>% pull(gene_symbol)
hallmark_ifn_gamma <- msig %>% filter(gs_name == "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE") %>% pull(gene_symbol)
hallmark_tnfa <- msig %>% filter(gs_name == "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB") %>% pull(gene_symbol)
hallmark_ros <- msig %>% filter(gs_name == "HALLMARK_REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES_PATHWAY") %>% pull(gene_symbol)
hallmark_hypoxia <- msig %>% filter(gs_name == "HALLMARK_HYPOXIA") %>% pull(gene_symbol)
hallmark_Apoptosis <- msig %>% filter(gs_name == "HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS") %>% pull(gene_symbol)

ifn_response <- c("Irf7", "Stat1", "Ifit1", "Ifit2", "Ifit3", "Isg15", "Oas1a", "Mx1") # Type I Interferon Response Response to viral and some bacterial PAMPs
nfkb_pathway <- c("Nfkb1", "Nfkb2", "Rel", "Relb", "Ikbkb", "Ikbkg", "Chuk", "Traf6", "Myd88", "Il1b", "Tnfa") # Master regulator of cytokine production and immune activation
amp_genes <- c("Lcn2", "Defb1", "Defb4", "Camp", "S100a8", "S100a9", "Slpi", "Reg3g", "Nos2")
neutrophil_recruitment <- c("Cxcl1", "Cxcl2", "Cxcr2", "Il1b", "Tnf", "S100a8", "S100a9", "Nlrp3", "Ptx3")
complement_pathway <- c("C1qa", "C1qb", "C1qc", "C3", "C5", "Cfb", "Cfh", "Cfd", "Cd55", "Cd59a")
# Query mouse necroptosis pathway
necroptosispathway_id <- "mmu04217"
library(KEGGREST)
Necropathway_info <- keggGet(necroptosispathway_id)
# Extract gene symbols
necroptosisgene_entries <- Necropathway_info[[1]]$GENE
necroptosismouse_genes <- necroptosisgene_entries[seq(2, length(necroptosisgene_entries), 2)]  # Every 2nd entry is the gene symbol
necroptosismouse_genes
necroptosismouse_genessymbol <- unique(sub("; .*", "", necroptosismouse_genes))  # Clean extra annotation
# 
tlr_id <- "mmu04620"
tlrpathway_info <- keggGet(tlr_id)
# Extract gene symbols
tlrgene_entries <- tlrpathway_info[[1]]$GENE
tlrmouse_genes <- tlrgene_entries[seq(2, length(tlrgene_entries), 2)]  # Every 2nd entry is the gene symbol
tlrmouse_genes
tlr_pathway <- unique(sub("; .*", "", tlrmouse_genes))  # 
tlr_pathway

cytokine_id <- "mmu04060"
cytokinepathway_info <- keggGet(cytokine_id)
# Extract gene symbols
cytokinegene_entries <-cytokinepathway_info[[1]]$GENE
cytokinemouse_genes <- cytokinegene_entries[seq(2, length(cytokinegene_entries), 2)]  # Every 2nd entry is the gene symbol
cytokinemouse_genes
cytokine_pathway <- unique(sub("; .*", "", cytokinemouse_genes))  # 
cytokine_pathway
#cytokine_pathway <- c("Cxcl1", "Cxcl2", "Cxcl10", "Il6", "Il1b", "Tnf", "Ccl2", "Ccl5", "Il10ra", "Il18r1") ## KEGG pathway: mmu04060

# Add module scores for each pathway

DefaultAssay(Pyelonephritis_Infection) <-"SCT"

Pyelonephritis_Infection <- AddModuleScore(
  Pyelonephritis_Infection,
  features = list(
    amp_genes,
    tlr_pathway,
    nfkb_pathway,
    neutrophil_recruitment,
    cytokine_pathway,
    complement_pathway,
    necroptosismouse_genessymbol,
    hallmark_tnfa,
    hallmark_ifn_gamma,
    hallmark_inflam,
    hallmark_angiogenesis,
    hallmark_tgfb,
    hallmark_em,
    hallmark_myogenesis,
    hallmark_ros,
    hallmark_hypoxia,
    hallmark_Apoptosis
  ),
  name = c(
    "Amp",
    "TLRSignaling",
    "NFKB",
    "Cytokine",
    "NeutrophilRecruitment",
    "ComplementPathway",
    "Necroptosis",
    "TNFASignaling",
    "InterferonGammaResponse",
    "InflammatoryResponse",
    "angiogenesis",
    "tgfbsignal",
    "epithelialmesenchymaltransition",
    "myogenesis",
    "ROS",
    "Hypoxia",
    "Apoptosis"
  )
)

# please make sure the order of the pathways is consistent with the order in the dotplot and heatmap
ColumnOrders<- colnames(Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data)[41:57]
paletteLength <- length(ColumnOrders)

length(colnames(Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data))
myColor = colorRampPalette(c("royalblue", "white","lightcoral"))(paletteLength)
myPalette <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")))

# Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data %>% head()
# create a data frame for dotplot from metadata
df<- Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data %>% 
  dplyr::select(Annotation, ColumnOrders) %>% pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Amp"):starts_with("Apopto"), 
               names_to = "Pathway", values_to = "Score") %>% 
  group_by(Annotation, Pathway) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    avg_score = mean(Score),
    pct_expr = sum(Score > 0) / n() * 100
  )

# plot 
df$avg_score <- as.numeric(df$avg_score)
df$pct_expr <- as.numeric(df$pct_expr)
dev.off()
FinalPathwayAvergeDotPlot<-ggplot(df, aes(x = Pathway, y = Annotation)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = pct_expr, color = avg_score)) +
 scale_color_viridis_c(option = "rocket") +
  geom_tile() +
  #scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral", direction = -1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Pathway Scores", x = "Pathway", y = "Cluster") +RotatedAxis() +coord_flip()
ggsave(
      filename = "FinalPathwayAvergeDotplots.pdf",
      plot = FinalPathwayAvergeDotPlot,
      height = 4,
      width = 6
    )
# using the pheatmap
FinalPathwayAvergeExp<-df %>% dplyr::select(Annotation, Pathway, avg_score)%>% pivot_wider(names_from = Pathway, values_from = avg_score) 
FinalPathwayAvergeExpTable<- FinalPathwayAvergeExp[,-1] %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(FinalPathwayAvergeExpTable) <-FinalPathwayAvergeExp$Annotation
FinalPathwayAvergeExpTable

FinalPathwayAvergeExpTable <- FinalPathwayAvergeExpTable[,ColumnOrders]
FinalPathwayAvergeExpTable
FinalPathwayAvergepheatmap<-pheatmap(t(FinalPathwayAvergeExpTable),fontsize=12,


                        fontsize_row = 10, scale="row",cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F,
                        color=myColor,
                        # main = "Infected associated signaling",
                        angle_col = 45,
                        treeheight_col = 0,  border_color = NA, treeheight_row=0)

ggsave(
      filename = "Figure1G_1gFinalPathwayAvergepheatmap.pdf",
      plot = FinalPathwayAvergepheatmap,
      height = 4,
      width = 6
    )


# then generate the pathway featuremap
# Generate the feature Plots
for (m in ColumnOrders) {
    # Generate DimPlot or SpatialDimPlot based on user's choice
    # Function to generate DimPlot plot
    #  j="Calr"
   # ColumnOrders
  #i=  "Apoptosis17"
  # we use this details to escape the figures that did not show up in spatial

    # get the maxium and minvalue of the pathway
   Maxvalue <- max(Pyelonephritis_Infection[[m]])
    Minvalue <- min(Pyelonephritis_Infection[[m]])

       PathwayMouseSpatialFeature <-
      SpatialFeaturePlot(
        Pyelonephritis_Infection,
        features = m,
        pt.size.factor = 1600,
        crop = TRUE
      ) &
      ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(colours = myPalette(4),
                                    limits = c(Minvalue, Maxvalue))
    
    # save the figure into the folder
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0("Spatial",m,"PathwayscoreFeaturePlot.pdf"),
      plot = PathwayMouseSpatialFeature,
      height = 3,
      width = 15
    )
  
}

```

Fig1H: SpatailFeaturePlots for the TNF-α, NF-κB, hypoxia, antimicrobial peptide, inflammatory response, and apoptotic pathways across timepoints (Day 0, 1, 3, 5, 7, and 28)
```{r}
# Figure 1G: Heatmap of infection-associated pathway enrichment across the 17 niches
# run the source of pathways 
ProgenyFeatures <- levels(factor(acts$source))
ProgenyFeatures
for (i in ProgenyFeatures ){
  p2 <-SpatialFeaturePlot(Pyelonephritis_Infection, features = i, pt.size.factor = 1600) +
  ggtitle(paste0(i," activity")) &
          ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(colours = myPalette(4), limits=c(-1,5))
  
  ggsave(paste0(i, "_Pyelonephritis_Infection_cluster_featurePlot_DecoupleR.pdf"), plot = p2, width = 20, height = 4)
}
```
